title: Director, Strategic Finance - Planning Systems
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Director, Strategic Finance - Planning Systems lead to join our Strategic Finance organization. Reporting to the VP, FP&A, you will own the architecture behind the company's consolidated planning and reporting cycles, designing how inputs from across the FP&A pillars flow into a coherent, system-based corporate view that informs decisions made by senior leadership, the executive team, and the Board. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who pairs strong financial and business acumen with deep experience in planning tools and finance transformation. You will own end-to-end workstreams, set the standard for how planning and reporting scale, and act as a force multiplier for the brocader FP&A team. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and gets energy from building durable infrastructure. You Will Own the consolidated planning and reporting engine behind the annual operating plan, long-range plan, and monthly/quarterly forecast cycles, covering data intake, consolidation, and on-time delivery of the outputs reviewed by senior leadership, and lead its evolution into a scalable, system-based architecture Serve as the functional and technical owner of the financial planning platform (e.g. evaluating EPM tools), leading design, implementation, enhancement, administration, and team enablement Own the planning systems roadmap end-to-end, including prioritization, UAT, governance, and change management Drive finance transformation projects that improve automation, standardization, and simplicity across planning and reporting workflows, including embedding AI where it raises analytical quality and reduces manual effort Design data flows and integrations connecting the planning platform to the ERP, data warehouse, and BI stack, partnering with Accounting, Data Engineering, and Analytics on architecture Produce executive-facing financial deliverables, including the Weekly Business Review, monthly OpEx review, and quarterly Board and Audit Committee materials, and build dashboards and reporting that surface KPIs and business insights with minimal manual assembly Partner with category, marketing, and ops finance counterparts to standardize how their inputs are gathered, pressure-tested, and consolidated into a single corporate view Establish best practices across systems controls, data governance, and planning process documentation You Have B.S. in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or equivalent experience 12+ years of progressive experience spanning strategic finance / FP&A and finance systems or finance transformation roles Strong financial and business acumen, including command of P&L mechanics, budgeting, forecasting, and the consolidation mechanics behind a company-wide planning cycle Hands-on experience implementing, administering, or owning an EPM / planning platform (Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive, Planful, or similar), including model design and integrations Demonstrated success leading a finance transformation initiative end-to-end, standing up or materially scaling planning systems and automated reporting, not just contributing components Ability to manipulate large datasets and translate them into clear, structured, decision-ready outputs Strong project management instincts, with the ability to run multiple workstreams simultaneously Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences, from system administrators to the executive team Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments Track record of leveraging AI and automation to improve finance workflows Nice to Have Proficiency with SQL and experience with BI tools (Looker, Amplitude); NetSuite or similar ERP integration experience Experience at a high-growth public company (recent IPO) or late-stage startup (Series C+) that has scaled through significant revenue and organizational growth Exposure to a public company's external reporting cycle (Board, Audit Committee, earnings/guidance) Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 401k benefits with employer matching contribution Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address. To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement .

title: Sr. Manager of CX Enablement
description: Who We Are Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. About You You've owned CX quality at a contact center scale of 200+ agents (in-house or BPO), built a QA framework from rubric through calibration, and shipped training programs that measurably moved agent performance. You're equally comfortable in a Looker dashboard and a Zendesk Guide CMS. You've worked alongside or implemented an AI deflection product (Sierra, Ada, Decagon, Forethought) and can speak credibly about what makes AI-mediated support actually work. Role Summary As Senior Manager of CX Enablement , you will own the quality, training, and knowledge management systems that power Imprint's customer experience. This is a strategic leadership role combining QA framework design, AI-powered deflection enablement, knowledge base ownership, and agent training excellence. You will drive the architecture that connects quality inputs to AI systems (Sierra), knowledge management, and training outputs—ensuring content quality compounds rather than degrades as Imprint scales. You'll partner closely with engineering, ops, product, and vendor teams to transform customer support from reactive to proactive through automation, rigorous quality frameworks, and data-driven training strategies. This role reports directly to the Director of Customer Operations and manages a small team of 2–3 associates focused on execution and continuous improvement. What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days Completed a comprehensive knowledge base audit with defined ownership model between CS, engineering, and ops, including refresh SLAs in Zendesk Designed and shipped a new QA framework that moves from manual contact center approaches to fully automated quality scoring with clear expectations Established Sierra AI deflection enablement system with daily feedback loops, gap detection, and content optimization for AI ingestion and delivery Built a scalable partner launch QA and training strategy and applied it to an active launch with measurable quality improvements over prior launches Created a structured training rehaul plan in collaboration with our outsourcing partner, focusing on strategic oversight and outcome monitoring Established trusted partnerships with key cross-functional stakeholders including vendor ops, AI product team, partner success, compliance, and legal Responsibilities Own the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality management frameworks that drive consistent agent performance across omnichannel support Lead knowledge base strategy and operations in Zendesk, including content audits, ownership models, refresh cadence, and optimization for both human agents and AI consumption Drive Sierra AI deflection strategy by analyzing feedback data, identifying content gaps, optimizing knowledge for LLM ingestion, and improving customer-facing AI delivery Partner with Imprints BPO training teams to design and monitor training programs that address systemic quality issues, leverage AI automation, and scale effectively with new partner launches Build and maintain the technical architecture that connects quality inputs (QA automation, CSAT, sentiment analysis) to training outputs and knowledge base improvements Use data from QM platforms, Sierra AI, and CSAT to diagnose root causes of quality issues—differentiating agent behavior from systemic or content gaps Lead partner launch readiness by designing QA strategies, training plans, and content requirements that prevent launch failures and training debt Establish cross-functional collaboration rhythms with vendor ops, engineering, product, fraud ops, partner success, compliance, and legal teams Manage and develop a team of 2–3 associates responsible for execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement of quality and training operations Qualifications Required 7+ years in customer experience, with 4+ years in quality management, training, enablement, or knowledge management roles Experience owning CX quality, training, and enablement at scale (100+ agents, in-house or outsourced), ideally omnichannel Hands-on experience implementing AI-powered deflection projects using tools like Sierra, Ada, Decagon, Forethought, or comparable LLM-based platforms Strong technical fluency with CX platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk Guide and Support, or comparable knowledge base and support systems (not homegrown tools) Experience with QM platforms such as Maestro QA, Klaus, Playbox, Stella Connect, Tether AI, or similar quality automation tools Exceptional writing skills with the ability to produce compliance-ready content that requires minimal iteration with legal or regulatory teams Data fluency: able to analyze QA trends, CSAT drivers, sentiment data, and agent performance metrics to identify systemic issues vs. behavior gaps Bias toward action and shipping—comfortable building frameworks that get adopted, not just designed Genuine curiosity about how AI is transforming customer service, with a demonstrated commitment to staying at the forefront of CX automation Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, regulated environments, or industries with complex compliance requirements Familiarity with training LMS tools and designing scalable learning programs Background in customer education, support operations, or contact center quality leadership Experience working with outsourced BPO partners and driving adoption of new quality or training standards Track record of redesigning legacy QA or training systems into modern, automated frameworks Perks & Benefits Competitive compensation and equity packages Leading configured work computers of your choice Flexible paid time off Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

title: Vulnerable Customer Advisor
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Remote | 💰 <span style="font-weight: 400;">£26,230</span> - £30,620 depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>This role will be working shifts between 6am and 10pm, Monday - Sunday (37.5 hours per week). </strong></p> <p><strong><em>We receive calls from customers who express feelings of distress, including thoughts of self-harm or harm to others, as well as challenges related to gambling and substance use.</em> </strong><strong><em>Please do not apply if you feel that these calls will be triggering for you to deal with.</em><br><br>⭐Our VAIB team<br></strong></p> <p><span class="">Are you passionate about making banking truly accessible and advocating for people when they need it most?</span><span class=""> Join Monzo’s dedicated Vulnerable Customers team to help deliver on our mission of making money work for everyone.</span><span class=""> In this role,</span> you will provide empathetic,<span class=""> specialist support to customers experiencing difficult circumstances,</span> from navigating mental or physical health challenges and major life events to managing daily financial worries. Working at the intersection of financial wellbeing and accessibility, you’ll connect customers with bespoke tools designed to give them control over their finances, while actively helping us break down barriers so that Monzo remains an inclusive, supportive space for every individual.</p> <p>About our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) Team -<a href="https://monzo.com/i/supporting-all-our-customers"> <strong>https://monzo.com/i/supporting-all-our-customers</strong></a></p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Taking escalations from fellow Customer Service Advisors, chatting to customers via the telephone and in app chat.</li> <li>Helping people with addictions make account adjustments to aid their recovery</li> <li>Helping people with various difficulties be fully understood by Monzo so we can help them to the best of our ability now and in the future</li> <li>Talking to people who are struggling to afford basic necessities, and find them the right help and support</li> <li>Talking to people who mention suicide, and figure out the best way to help them</li> <li>Advising your fellow Customer Service Advisors on tone of voice, phrasing, and actions for vulnerable people</li> <li>Understanding a customer’s financial accessibility needs and making adjustments to support their journey with Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience working with vulnerable people </li> <li>Are comfortable and confident managing a high volume of calls of a sensitive nature </li> <li>Have the ability to prioritise difficult conversations effectively</li> <li>Have high levels of empathy and compassion</li> <li>Have a strong sense of personal boundaries and resilience</li> <li>You can start on <strong>18th January 2027 </strong>and attend full time training Monday to Friday 9am - 5.30pm for 8 weeks</li> <li>Have a strong team working ethic</li> </ul> <p><strong>💰 What’s in it for you </strong></p> <p>💰<span style="font-weight: 400;">£26,230</span> - £30,620 per year depending on experience </p> <p>📍This role is based remotely</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> <p><strong>🎂 </strong>We'll guarantee time off on your birthday (if you want it) with the exception of your training period. This will come from your regular holiday balance and provided you have enough to cover it.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Application stage and questions</li> <li>Initial call with the recruiter </li> <li>Final stage interview with 2 team managers lasting around 1 hour</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-SW2</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Vertriebsleiter (m/w/d) Bodenbeschichtungen
description: Für unseren Mandanten, einen etablierten Hersteller innovativer Systemlösungen für die Bauindustrie, suchen wir einen Vertriebsleiter (m/w/d) für Deutschland. Das Unternehmen steht für hochwertige Produkte, nachhaltiges Wachstum und langfristige Kundenpartnerschaften. ______________________________________________________________________ Ihre Mission: Sie übernehmen die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Key-Account-Teams und fördern die individuelle Entwicklung Ihrer Mitarbeitenden. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team entwickeln Sie bestehende Vertriebsstrukturen weiter und setzen strategische Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Marktbearbeitung erfolgreich um. Sie analysieren relevante Vertriebskennzahlen, leiten daraus Maßnahmen ab und stellen die Erreichung der Umsatz- und Ertragsziele sicher. Sie erkennen neue Marktchancen, erschließen Wachstumspotenziale und bauen langfristige Beziehungen zu strategisch wichtigen Kunden sowie Geschäftspartnern auf. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichen wie Produktmanagement, Entwicklung, Marketing und Produktion treiben Sie innovative Lösungen voran und vertreten das Unternehmen professionell bei Kunden, Veranstaltungen und Branchenevents. ______________________________________________________________________ Ihr Profil: Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer leitenden Vertriebsfunktion, idealerweise im Umfeld der Bauchemie, Bodenbeschichtung oder Betoninstandsetzung. Sie können nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau von Märkten, der Entwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Führung leistungsstarker Vertriebsteams vorweisen. Der professionelle Umgang mit Key-Account-Kunden sowie die Steuerung von Vertriebsprozessen anhand von Kennzahlen und CRM-Systemen gehören zu Ihrem Arbeitsalltag. Kenntnisse im Bereich Ausschreibungen, Planungsprozesse (z. B. HOAI) oder Bauwerksdiagnostik sind von Vorteil. Sie überzeugen durch unternehmerisches Denken, eine ausgeprägte Zielorientierung sowie sicheres Auftreten in Verhandlungen und Präsentationen. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Entscheidungsfreude und die Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands runden Ihr Profil ab. ______________________________________________________________________ Das Unternehmen bietet: Eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsaufgabe mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen. Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle auf Basis von Vertrauensarbeitszeit. 30 Tage Urlaub sowie eine attraktive, leistungsorientierte Vergütung inklusive Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung. Umfangreiche Zusatzleistungen wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und weitere finanzielle Benefits. Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Förderung Ihrer beruflichen Karriere. Angebote im Bereich Gesundheitsförderung und Fitness sowie regelmäßige Team- und Unternehmensevents. Moderne Arbeitsmittel, eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, in der Eigeninitiative und neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind. Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Ihre Bewerbung wird von uns diskret, vertraulich und DSGVO-konform behandelt. Eine Weitergabe Ihrer Unterlagen erfolgt nur nach vorheriger Abstimmung mit Ihnen. Das erwartet Sie Wir bieten Ihnen eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge für Ihre langfristige Absicherung. Profitieren Sie von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten, Gutscheinen und Ermäßigungen im Alltag. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Remote arbeiten unterstützen Ihre Work-Life-Balance, ergänzt durch eine komplette Home-Office-Ausstattung. Nutzen Sie Angebote zur beruflichen Bildung für Ihre persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Ein Firmenwagen, ein Firmenhandy und ein Firmenlaptop stehen Ihnen zur Verfügung. Freuen Sie sich zudem auf Teamevents und Firmenfeiern, kostenlose Getränke am Arbeitsplatz sowie kostenloses Parken. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Contract Talent Acquisition Sourcer, Sales (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Contract Talent Acquisition Sourcer at GitLab, you'll help build strong candidate pipelines for our sales team in the APJ region in a fully remote, distributed company. You'll focus on finding and engaging passive talent for sales roles, while partnering closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and business leaders to understand hiring needs and local market dynamics. </p> <p>This is a highly outbound role where your research, outreach, and judgment will directly influence hiring outcomes. You'll also help strengthen sourcing practices by mapping talent markets, building pipelines, and improving how we identify and connect with great candidates in a values-driven environment. In this role, you will primarily focus on engaging with Account Executive talent to build proactive pipelines and benches, in addition to working active requisitions.</p> <p>Please note this is a 12 month contract. </p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Source, screen and engage passive candidates for sales roles across the APJ region using LinkedIn, online research, and other outbound channels.</li> <li>Build representative candidate pipelines with meaningful focus on identifying talent from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.</li> <li>Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements, business priorities, and ideal candidate profiles.</li> <li>Map talent markets and gather intelligence on competitors, locations, and candidate pools to inform sourcing strategies.</li> <li>Assess candidate alignment for specific roles, teams, and GitLab's values, and share clear recommendations with recruiting partners.</li> <li>Screen and qualify candidates, building and maintaining talent benches across multiple countries in the APJ region to ensure strong pipeline depth and readiness for evolving business needs.</li> <li>Deliver a strong candidate experience through thoughtful outreach, timely communication, and professional relationship building.</li> <li>Continuously improve sourcing workflows, outreach approaches, and research methods to increase efficiency and quality.</li> <li>Maintain accurate activity and candidate data in applicant tracking and recruiting systems, and stay open to learning new tools and processes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Relevant experience in recruiting and/or sourcing, including direct experience sourcing passive candidates in a fully outbound environment.</li> <li>Experience sourcing for Account Executive and other sales roles, ideally within the software industry.</li> <li>Strong research skills and the ability to identify, map, and engage talent across competitive regional and global markets.</li> <li>Experience working directly with recruiters and hiring managers to align on hiring needs and adjust sourcing strategies as priorities change.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust across teams, candidates, and time zones.</li> <li>Strong organization skills and comfort managing multiple searches, deadlines, and competing priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and recruiting tools. Experience with Greenhouse or LinkedIn Recruiter is ideal.</li> <li>Comfort working remotely in an asynchronous environment, along with willingness to learn and use tools such as GitLab.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Talent Acquisition team at GitLab helps the company grow by finding people who can contribute to our mission and thrive in our all-remote environment. Within that group, sourcing plays a key role in reaching talent that may not be actively applying, especially in competitive markets and business-critical functions. You'll work with teammates who care deeply about candidate experience, thoughtful partnership, and inclusive hiring practices. The team values clear communication, strong market insight, and steady iteration in how we work. This role is especially important as GitLab continues to grow go-to-market teams in APJ, where strong regional knowledge and effective collaboration across time zones can help teams hire with more focus and confidence.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Staff Global Partner Programs Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Global Partner Programs Manager, you’ll turn GitLab’s ecosystem strategy into repeatable programs that help partners create value across the full customer lifecycle: Acquire, Commit, and Consume. You’ll own a portfolio of global partner program workstreams, such as partner sourcing, services attach, adoption, renewals, managed service providers (MSPs), global systems integrators (GSIs), hyperscaler, and marketplace motions, and make them clear, usable, and measurable for partners and sellers across regions.</p> <p>This is a strategic individual contributor role. You’ll lead through expertise and influence rather than direct reports. You’ll partner with Ecosystem Sales, Partner Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Enablement to launch and improve programs, recommend changes to incentives and policy, and connect program activity to pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes. In your first year, you’ll focus on building a clear roadmap for your portfolio, simplifying partner requirements and rules of engagement, and setting up consistent reporting on program performance. As the team grows, this role may expand to include leading partner program managers.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the roadmap, priorities, and execution for an assigned set of global partner programs across Acquire, Commit, and Consume, within agreed strategy, policy, and budget.</li> <li>Coordinate requirements, milestones, owners, and risks across Ecosystem Sales, Partner Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Services, Customer Success, Product, Enablement, and regional teams.</li> <li>Improve the partner journey from onboarding and capability building through activation, co-selling, adoption, and expansion, turning partner and field feedback into prioritized program improvements.</li> <li>Support the design and rollout of partner incentives, including margin, rebates, market development funds (MDF), deal registration, services attach, and consumption, and build business cases with Finance and Ecosystem leadership.</li> <li>Maintain program guides, eligibility rules, approval flows, and documentation, partnering with Legal and Finance so programs are compliant, auditable, and easy to understand.</li> <li>Create playbooks, launch materials, and training with Enablement and regional teams to drive adoption of new programs and commercial changes.</li> <li>Define success measures for each program, such as partner-sourced pipeline, services attach, adoption, and incentive use, and partner with Revenue Operations to report on them consistently.</li> <li>Use performance data to recommend investment changes, reduce exceptions and manual work, and escalate decisions that go beyond your scope.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in partner programs, channel strategy, alliances, ecosystem operations, or a related go-to-market function.</li> <li>A track record of taking complex programs from design through launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.</li> <li>Understanding of partner economics, including incentives, deal registration, MDF, services programs, co-selling, and rules of engagement.</li> <li>Ability to lead global, cross-functional work without direct authority, setting clear owners, decisions, and escalation paths.</li> <li>Analytical judgment and the ability to connect program activity to pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes.</li> <li>Strong written communication, including the ability to make complex commercial concepts simple for partners and sellers.</li> <li>Program management discipline across prioritization, dependencies, risk, and follow-through, with a bias toward practical execution.</li> <li>Familiarity with SaaS, cloud, DevOps, or AI partner ecosystems; consumption-based pricing; or hyperscaler marketplace and co-sell programs is a plus.</li> <li>Openness to candidates with transferable experience who can build trust across teams and turn strategy into results.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Ecosystem team helps GitLab grow through partners, including GSIs, MSPs, professional services partners, resellers, and cloud hyperscalers. We’re building a more intentional partner model that goes beyond the transaction to create value across sourcing, co-selling, deployment, adoption, services, and consumption. We work asynchronously across regions as part of a remote-first company, with occasional travel for partner meetings, planning, and program launches.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. title: Manager: Compliance Advisory and Data Protection
location: London or remote within the UK
description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The Team You'll join our Service guild and work across first line operations, sales and produt. Working closely with Protect (our second line) you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance solutions look like. Then implement them , keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow. The opportunity We want compliance and data protection built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on DPO and compliance adviser, in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into. What success looks like In your first year, you’ve taken ownership of our data protection agenda. You’ve gone looking for ways to improve, made the changes happen, and given our senior leaders an honest picture of where we stand. You’ve sought out our operations, sales and product teams and shown them that working with you makes things smoother, not slower. Now they bring you in early by default. You’ve guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. And you’ve put clear governance and outcome monitoring in place for our live products, so Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation. To do this you'll be involved in: Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments, from first idea through product approval to launch, with data protection built in from the start. Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures. Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material. Marketing: working on marketing materials, both ours and our customers’, to make sure they comply with regulation and our own policies, and that our financial promotions are properly challenged. Service (Operations): building regulatory and data protection requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use. Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time. Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, including personal data breaches, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes. Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge. Data protection: being our Data Protection Officer (DPO), which means: advising our teams on their obligations, including data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and transfer risk assessments (TRAs) monitoring and auditing how well we comply with the UK GDPR, other data protection laws and our own policies training colleagues and raising awareness of data protection being our contact point for the ICO and for people with questions or requests about their data As our DPO, you’ll report directly to our COO and have the independence you need to do the job well. We’ll involve you early in anything that affects personal data. We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves is for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where you can make the biggest difference. We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are. Your background We need a proactive doer. You get stuck in without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable tackling regulations you haven’t met before. You use your experience and expertise to help our teams find simple, clear and compliant solutions. Your advice is balanced, easy to follow and focused on the risks that matter most. You want to push the business forward, and you see good compliance as part of how we get there. To ensure this, we're looking for people who have: Compliance experience in the first (preferred) or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm. Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products , like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations. As well as familiarity with HMRC requirements like BBSI and AEOI reporting. Expert knowledge of data protection law and practice , including the UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, PECR and the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025. Hands-on experience turning regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams. A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against. The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn’t right. A love of writing . We have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ). Ideally, you would also: Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar. Have been a DPO, or worked closely with one, in a regulated firm. Have worked in finance or banking. What can we offer you? We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future. Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE) Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year) Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment. As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks How long will the process take? We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other. Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience. Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements. Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin. Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview. Step 5 : Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here . How do I apply? Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next. We’re remote-first We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it. Under representation At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team. Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency. title: Senior Client Delivery Lead - GenerationFlex (w/f/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Client Delivery Lead to support our German GenerationFlex clients on their Kraken onboarding journey and wider business transformation. 🐙 About GenerationFlex The energy system is changing fast. Renewables are growing, demand is becoming more peaky, and grid constraints are showing up in more places, more often. Kraken GenerationFlex is how utilities and asset owners navigate that complexity at scale. We help organisations run portfolios of grid-scale assets - BESS, renewables, and co-located sites - in a way that's commercially aligned, operationally safe, and practical to manage day to day. From trading enablement and control & dispatch, to alerts, data services, and settlements, our platform gives teams the visibility and automation they need to respond well to change across multiple assets, markets, and regulations. We're a mission-driven team making the big green dent in the world, and we're looking for people ready to help shape what that looks like next. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in: The Delivery Team We are looking for an experienced Senior Client Delivery Lead to build industry-leading product experiences for our European clients. If you love making things better for clients, building great products, working with technology (software + hardware), bringing people together to find solutions, then you’ve come to the right place. GenerationFlex is different to the wider Kraken universe and highly cross-functional: our product bridges software and hardware in order to allow our clients’ trading teams to effectively control their assets across multiple markets and asset types. The Senior Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility for creating, managing and prioritising the client onboarding roadmap to ensure clarity and understanding with both the Kraken and client business. They need to always work in partnership with the product, software engineering, asset onboarding and electrical engineering teams at Kraken and are the main point of contact for our clients and their partners. 🚀 What you'll own Client relationship: manage and coordinate a multitude of stakeholders during the initial client implementation phase, ranging from construction site managers to software engineers to senior business stakeholders. Be the first point of contact for tech development and issue resolution during the implementation phase, organise workstreams, flag dependencies, coordinate internal and external teams, and provide clear and concise updates to keep everyone on track and on the same page. Regional Market Expertise: act as the subject matter expert for our clients and wider Kraken teams thanks to your deep understanding of the German and European energy markets, including hardware and connectivity requirements, TSOs and DSOs, re-dispatch, ancillary-service requirements and competitor landscape. Help evaluate hardware and software solutions for regional fit. title: Demo Architect, EMEA
location: Remote Ireland; Remote, Germany; Remote, Spain; Remote, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Demo Architect, you'll help GitLab teams and customers get hands-on with our platform faster and with less friction. This role reports to the Senior Director of our Solutions Architecture Center of Excellence, with day-to-day partnership from the current team lead. You'll build and improve the tools, applications, and infrastructure that support field team demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments across the field. </p> <p>What makes this role unique is its mix of software engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing collaboration. You'll work like an engineer for much of the role, while also partnering with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, and others to make sure what we build is practical, usable, and aligned to how the field sells.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and maintain tools, applications, and workflows that support demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments.</li> <li>Expand the Demo Architect Portal to improve automation, self-service, and scalability for field teams and partners.</li> <li>Provision and support infrastructure that enables hands-on customer experiences across<a href="https://gitlab.com"> GitLab.com</a>, demo instances, and internal environments.</li> <li>Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, Marketing, Revenue Operations, UX, and Engineering to understand needs and deliver practical technical solutions.</li> <li>Learn and document go-to-market workflows (e.g., how teams run demos/workshops/trials) and automate the steps that waste time.</li> <li>Create technical workshop assets and enablement content that support pre-sales and technical selling for individual contributors.</li> <li>Advise on sales opportunities when specialized technical demo support or custom solutions are needed.</li> <li>Improve the presenter experience by reducing manual setup work and making demo workflows easier to use and repeat.</li> <li>Support internal teams that rely on demo or test infrastructure, helping keep those environments available and useful.</li> <li>Troubleshoot urgent demo/workshop environment issues under pressure and communicate status clearly to stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building software, systems, or internal tools that support technical users or business teams.</li> <li>Ability to deliver production-grade software and automation with attention to reliability, maintainability, and documentation.</li> <li>Ability to work across application development and infrastructure, with comfort navigating provisioning, automation, and service workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools to shorten investigation time when something breaks.</li> <li>Comfort communicating and collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Marketing, UX, and Engineering.</li> <li>Understanding of how to design and iterate on solutions for usability and repeatability, not just technical correctness, with awareness that the end user may be a seller or Solutions Architect.</li> <li>Ability to operate independently in a remote, asynchronous environment, with willingness to travel periodically for team offsites and occasional in-person planning/whiteboarding sessions.</li> <li>Exposure to technical demos, workshops, trials, or enablement assets, and/or interest in learning the pre-sales context; transferable experience from software engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, solutions architecture, or similar technical paths.   #LI-CM1</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>On the Demo Architect team at GitLab, we support the field’s demo, workshop, and trial experiences by maintaining shared tooling and the infrastructure behind internal demo and test instances used across GitLab. We’re a small, globally distributed group that collaborates asynchronously across regions and adapts quickly to changing needs, with a current focus on scaling automation, enabling more self-service, extending support to partners, and maintaining reliable internal infrastructure.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Content Creator(in) / Social Media Mitarbeiter(in) (m/w/d) – Werkstudent
description: Du liebst Social Media, sprudelst vor Ideen und hast Lust, mit deiner Kreativität wirklich etwas zu bewegen? Dann bist du bei MINI MILKYS® genau richtig! Wir sind ein junges, wachsendes Label für nachhaltige Babybekleidung mit einer starken Community, einer klaren Mission und viel Herz. Unser Ziel: den Alltag von Eltern mit durchdachten, soften und mitwachsenden Baby-Einteilern liebevoll einfacher machen. Und genau dafür brauchen wir dich! Deine Aufgaben: Was dich erwartet: Ideenfindung & Konzept: Du überlegst dir kreative Video-Ideen mit Fokus auf "Problem-Lösungs-Content", die Mamas echte Tipps geben und den Alltagsnutzen unserer Produkte klar zeigen. Präsenz vor der Kamera: Du bist das Gesicht dieser Videos. Du stehst selbstbewusst und sympathisch vor der Kamera und demonstrierst echte Alltags-Szenarien. Dreh & Schnitt: Du filmst und schneidest fesselnde Kurzvideos für unseren Instagram-Feed unsere Werbeanzeigen (Meta Ads). Performance-Fokus: Du produzierst Inhalte, die nicht nur ästhetisch sind, sondern begeistern und verkaufen. Dabei legst du besonderen Wert auf starke Hooks. Deine Qualifikation: Was du mitbringen solltest: Du hast große Lust auf Video-Kreation und fühlst dich zu 100 % wohl damit, dein Gesicht für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle und bezahlten Werbeanzeigen zu zeigen. Du verstehst, wie ein Social-Media-Video psychologisch aufgebaut sein muss, damit es „konvertiert“ – also aus Zuschauern auch wirklich Käufer macht. Du gehst sicher mit gängigen Design- und Videoschnitt-Tools (wie Canva, CapCut o. ä.) um und hast ein gutes Gespür für Ästhetik und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends. Du verwaltest Instagram eigenständig und hast ein echtes Händchen dafür, eine Community aktiv zu pflegen und zum Wachsen zu bringen. Du arbeitest selbständig, setzt Ideen zügig und unkompliziert in die Tat um. Du hast idealerweise einen Bezug zu Baby- und Mama-Themen (kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus!). Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch Deine Benefits: Was dich bei uns erwartet: Ein sicherer Minijob in einem wachsenden Start-up. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Gründerin Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeit super flexibel einteilen Mitarbeiterrabatte auf alle Kollektionen Raum für kreative Projekte, neue Formate & deine Ideen Eigenverantwortung ab Tag 1 – wir freuen uns auf deine Handschrift Klingt genau nach dir? Schick uns stattdessen einfach eine kurze Nachricht mit ein paar Worten zu dir und – ganz wichtig – Links zu deinen bisherigen Reels/TikToks oder direkt ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo von dir. Wir wollen sehen, wie du vor der Kamera wirkst! Wir freuen uns riesig auf dich! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
