title: Growth Product Manager
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. Growth Product Manager About This Role We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to build a product-led growth motion for YipitAgent, our company's latest flagship product. You’ll own the customer journey from first impression through paid conversion: how prospects discover YipitAgent, understand its value, start a trial, become deeply engaged, and convert into paying customers. Your work may span our SEO/AEO strategy, trial UX, in-product engagement, lifecycle communications, and pricing/packaging. You’ll collaborate closely with core product, design, engineering, data, marketing, and customer-facing teams. What Success Looks Like Organic inbounds become our primary channel for new customer acquisition. More visitors start trials and reach meaningful value quickly. Trialists engage deeply and consistently throughout their trials. More trialists convert into paying customers. Measurable increases in active users per account Key Responsibilities Optimize our SEO/AEO by leveraging our proprietary data and the latest technologies & tactics Own and improve the growth funnel from acquisition through trial activation, engagement, conversion, and re-engagement. Define and measure clear goals and success metrics for each stage of the customer journey. Discover ‘aha’ moments through interviews, behavioral data, funnel analysis, and experimentation and incorporate those moments into the UX appropriately. Design and optimize trial onboarding, in-product education, activation moments, and upgrade experiences. Develop engagement and re-engagement tactics, including proactive and personalized lifecycle touchpoints. Incorporate growth tactics into the core product experience so engagement reinforces itself and spreads to other users Explore and test pricing, packaging, and trial structures that improve conversion while preserving customer trust. Partner with designers and engineers to prototype, launch, measure, and iterate on new experiences. Build a disciplined experimentation practice that balances rapid learning with a coherent customer experience. Communicate insights, priorities, results, and tradeoffs clearly across the company. Qualifications & Skills 5+ years of growth product management, product marketing, or similarly relevant experience. A track record of improving acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, or conversion. Strong product and UX judgment, with the ability to turn ambiguous problems into intuitive experiences. Highly analytical and comfortable working with funnel metrics, cohorts, experiments, and behavioral data. Strong customer discovery skills and the ability to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence. Experience with product-led growth, self-serve trials, or B2B SaaS products. Familiarity with SEO/AEO, lifecycle communications, and pricing or packaging experimentation. Comfortable moving between strategy and execution—from defining the growth model to reviewing a trial screen or drafting an email. Excellent collaborator and communicator across design, engineering, data, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams. This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above! Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $170,000, with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 10% . Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

title: Software Engineer (Engineer III to Principal) - Formal Methods
description: Why us? Blockchain technology is enabling a rapidly-growing era of innovation for the digital world. It is crucial that blockchain code such as protocols and smart contracts are provably secure and correct. Once deployed, they are public and cannot be changed. Vulnerabilities and bugs in such programs regularly put millions of dollars at stake. This is where CertiK comes in. We are the leading blockchain security company. Our goal is to secure the cyber world by applying cutting edge techniques from academia to secure blockchain code. Come and join this ambitious mission as a research software engineer to work on automated analyses for provably secure and correct blockchain applications! What you will do You will design and develop tools that automatically ensure the correctness of smart contracts or identify security issues and bugs in smart contracts. We have software engineer positions available at all levels of seniority. Title and responsibilities will be commensurate with experience and background. As part of our multinational team of programming language experts, you will participate in the development of tools that rest upon techniques such as symbolic model checking, SAT/SMT solving, abstract interpretation, data flow analysis, and deductive verification. You will have the opportunity to work on all stages of tool development from idea generation to implementation and iterative improvements. Our team is highly supportive and collaborative with great opportunities to learn and grow. About you You have a background in programming language theory and automated reasoning and love to work on the forefront of applying results from theoretical computer science. You love to tackle computationally hard problems and have a proven track record of achieving results, where results are people using your tool to do their jobs. You are collaborative: you share ideas, love to brainstorm with peers, and give and receive feedback. You are comfortable with the unknown and understand that #startuplife means that you will be wearing multiple hats. Responsibilities Extend the scope and depth of our automated program verification tools and brainstorm, design, and implement new tools. Adapt and improve algorithms for symbolic software model checking. Examples include bounded model checking (BMC), counterexample-guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR), and property directed reachability (IC3/PDR). Build and extend translators from different input languages into intermediate representations, optimizing the generated models for automated analysis. Identify new classes of security properties of smart contracts and formalize properties for use in our automated verification tools. Closely collaborate with other software engineers in developing tools and set technical direction for solving problems in consultation with your team and management. Work on all aspects of delivering working software that meets customer needs, including analysis, design, automated testing, operations, CI/CD, measuring results, incorporating customer feedback, and support. Required Qualifications Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field or 5 years of equivalent experience. Minimum of 4 years of software development experience (includes internships, software developed during research, and open-source development). Minimum of 2 years of experience with one or more of the following: model checking, formal verification, SAT/SMT solving (Z3, CVC4, Yices, MathSAT, SMTInterpol), abstract interpretation, or closely related disciplines. Demonstrated knowledge of fundamental computer science concepts such as data structures, algorithms, mathematical logic, and automata theory. Preferred Qualifications PhD in the broader field of automated reasoning. Publication record in conferences like POPL, CAV, TACAS, FMCAD, FM, etc. Experience in functional programming (OCaml or Haskell). Strong and creative problem-solving skills; always willing to learn and embrace new technologies and to collaborate. Prior experience in a professional software development environment. title: Director of Product Marketing
description: Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started! Proof operates identity infrastructure for high-consequence transactions. Built on a WebTrust-audited certificate authority and PKI-anchored verifiable credentials, Proof helps more than 8,000 businesses, from financial institutions and mortgage lenders to insurers and wealth managers, verify who is on the other side of a transaction. Having created the online notarization category, we're now extending into portable digital identity with our Verifiable Digital Credential (VDC) for banks, and into authorization for AI agents. As Director of Product Marketing, you'll turn that technical foundation into positioning that a bank's Chief Risk Officer, head of digital, and compliance team all understand and act on. Day to day, you'll work across Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape messaging, lead launches, equip Sales to win, and make sure the market sees Proof as the trusted identity layer. You'll also lead and develop the product marketing function, starting with the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager. What you’ll do as the Director of Product Marketing at Proof: Positioning and messaging: Own product and solution positioning and the messaging architecture (value propositions, proof points, and differentiation) across the VDC, identity verification, eSign/eNotary, and agentic authorization, tailored by segment (banking, mortgage, insurance, wealth) and buyer persona. Launches and go-to-market: Run the launch process for new products and major features, from tiering and readiness through announcement, enablement, an post-launch measurement. Shape use-case plays such as account opening, high-value money movement, title and closing, and agent-initiated transactions with Revenue Marketing and Sales. Sales enablement: Build and maintain the core sales toolkit, including pitch decks, solution briefs, discovery guides, business-case and ROI tools, objection handling, and demo narratives. Run ongoing enablement for Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partners. Market and competitive insight: Lead win/loss analysis, customer interviews, persona and buying-committee research, and competitive intelligence across identity verification, digital credentials, eSignature, and fraud prevention vendors, including maintained battlecards. Product partnership: Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap priorities. Track regulatory developments (CIP/KYC, digital identity, and eNotary legislation) and translate them into market opportunities and messaging. Cross-functional content: Supply product and roadmap content for analyst briefings (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, Liminal, Celent, Datos Insights) with the Director of Communications, and product inputs for demand programs, content, and events. Team leadership: Manage and develop the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager and grow the product marketing team over time, so that product, partner, and customer messaging stay aligned. What we're looking for: 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience at a SaaS, fintech, identity, security, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years leading product marketing teams and launches end to end Experience marketing technical or API-driven products to regulated enterprise buyers, ideally financial institutions. A record of creating positioning for a new or emerging category, with launches that measurably improved pipeline and win rates. Enough technical fluency to understand PKI, cryptographic credentials, identity verification, and fraud concepts, and to explain them simply and accurately. Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage executives, customers, and analysts. You’ll really stand out if you have: Familiarity with digital identity standards (W3C Verifiable Credentials, ISO mDL, NIST 800-63) or KYC/AML compliance. Experience marketing AI or agentic products and the trust and authorization questions they raise. Experience with developer- or platform-led motions alongside enterprise sales. Position logistics: Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process. Our Proof Pillars: Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow. Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own. Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success. Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win! Here are some of our great benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date Unlimited Sick and Vacation time 14 paid company holidays 12 weeks of paid parental leave 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit Monthly work from home stipend Professional development credit Monthly reimbursement for Wellness And more! Compensation This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, discretionary bonus typically paid annually, the benefits listed above, and equity. Additional Information This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 23, 2026. Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications. Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Group Product Manager, Data Feeds
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: YipitData is building the default intelligence platform for anyone evaluating companies and markets. Our data feeds are central to that ambition, bringing proprietary and exclusively licensed data directly into our clients’ research, investment, and business workflows. We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead and grow our Data Feeds product management team. You will own the strategy and performance of a portfolio of data products, develop a strong team of PMs, and help build a more connected, scalable feeds business serving fundamental investors, quantitative and systematic funds, and corporate customers. This is a player-coach role . Alongside managing the team and setting portfolio direction, you will directly own a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative - from customer discovery and product strategy through development, launch, and ongoing performance. You should enjoy moving between portfolio decisions, coaching PMs, and working through the details of a product yourself. Our opportunity extends beyond bringing more datasets to market. We are building differentiated products around clear customer problems, combining data and capabilities where they create greater value, and making our feeds easier to evaluate, integrate, and use. You will help determine where we invest, how our products fit together, and how we translate our data advantage into durable growth. As Our Group Product Manager, Data Feeds, You Will: Lead and Develop the Product Team Manage, coach, and grow a team of product managers, strengthening their customer discovery, strategic judgment, execution, and commercial ownership. Establish clear product responsibilities, goals, and decision-making expectations, giving PMs the autonomy and support to own their products. Build effective practices for planning, roadmap reviews, customer feedback, and performance measurement. Recruit and develop talent as the team grows, while maintaining a high bar for product thinking and accountability. Lead Product Portfolio Strategy and Execution Own a cohesive product portfolio strategy aligned with the broader business direction set by the Head of Data Feeds, defining how our feeds fit together, serve customer needs, and deliver differentiated value. Guide PMs in developing product visions and roadmaps that strengthen both their individual products and the overall portfolio. Prioritize across product roadmaps and shared capabilities, balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, and available resources; partner with the Head of Data Feeds on broader investment decisions. Work with PMs to validate use cases and commercial demand early, including during the evaluation of new data sources. Identify portfolio gaps, overlap, and opportunities to combine datasets, reuse methodologies, and extend products across customer segments. Use customer feedback and product performance to recommend which offerings to scale, improve, consolidate, or retire, and lead execution of agreed decisions. Directly Own and Build Products Serve as the hands-on PM for a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative, owning its vision, roadmap, requirements, and outcomes. Lead customer discovery, investigate the underlying data, and translate customer needs into clear product decisions. Partner with Data, Engineering, Data Science, and Quant Research to assess feasibility, shape requirements, and bring products to market. Stay close to client evaluations and integrations, using feedback to improve the product and establish practices the broader team can reuse. Drive Commercial Performance Share accountability with commercial partners for portfolio revenue growth, retention, expansion, and product economics. Partner with Revenue, Client Strategy, Product Marketing, and Solutions Consulting on pricing, packaging, positioning, and effective sales and evaluation processes. Build a clear portfolio story that helps customers understand which products meet their needs and how those products work together. Balance near-term client requests with repeatable market opportunities, ensuring commitments inform a scalable roadmap. Define and track success through customer adoption, evaluation conversion, time to value, retention, and commercial results. Build a Consistent, Reliable Client Experience Establish product expectations for data quality, coverage, timeliness, documentation, and delivery across the portfolio. Partner with Data and Engineering on quality controls, monitoring, change management, and issue resolution. Improve how customers discover, evaluate, onboard, integrate, and receive ongoing support for feeds, working with Applications and client-facing teams. Ensure clients can understand each product’s methodology, limitations, historical changes, and appropriate use cases. Help build a repeatable experience for quant and systematic customers, including the data history, consistency, and transparency required for rigorous evaluation. Connect Teams Around Shared Outcomes Align priorities and responsibilities across Product, Data, Engineering, Research, Quant, Applications, and commercial teams. Partner with Quant Research on systematic investor requirements and research-informed product improvements. Work with data sourcing and partnerships teams to evaluate opportunities against customer needs, licensing constraints, quality, and economics. Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, progress, and risks clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners. You Are Likely To Succeed If: Significant product management experience, typically 7+ years, including ownership of commercial data products, data feeds, or similarly data-intensive B2B products. Experience directly managing and developing product managers, with evidence of improving both team performance and individual growth. A track record of taking products from customer discovery through launch and scaling, with measurable customer and business outcomes. Strong portfolio judgment: you can prioritize across products, allocate investment, and make difficult tradeoffs. Commercial fluency, including experience contributing to pricing, packaging, revenue growth, retention, or product economics. Hands-on analytical ability, including proficiency in SQL and comfort using Python to investigate data and assess product questions. Technical fluency in data products, including schemas, methodologies, quality, delivery mechanisms, and the implications of product changes for clients. Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align teams you do not directly manage. A desire to remain a hands-on product owner while building and leading a team. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with alternative data, financial data, or investment research products. Familiarity with fundamental, quantitative, or systematic investment workflows, including dataset evaluation, backtesting, and integration. Experience building a portfolio that serves multiple customer segments or combines multiple data sources. Experience with third-party data partnerships, licensing considerations, and vendor dependencies. Familiarity with APIs, cloud-based data delivery, and data quality and operational reliability practices. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above! Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $190k - 205k, with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 15% . Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks. The compensation package also includes equity. This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

title: Trust & Integrity Specialist
description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role We're looking for a Trust & Integrity Specialist to protect the integrity of the patient experience and the Solace platform. Sitting within the Customer Experience team, you'll serve as a dedicated resource for identifying, investigating, and resolving situations that pose risk to the patient or advocate experience. This role sits at the intersection of patient safety, conduct oversight, and operational risk. You'll own the review of flagged cases, monitor for emerging patterns, manage complaints with care and urgency, and ensure that the people and systems patients interact with are operating within Solace's protocols and standards. Reporting to the T&I Manager, you'll work closely with QA, operations, and internal stakeholders to maintain a trustworthy, safe, and high-quality experience for every patient we serve. Today this work centers on advocate-facing cases; as Trust & Integrity expands, the same function will extend to other patient-facing groups (CX, physicians, and beyond). What You'll Do Patient Safety & Complaint Management Serve as the primary point of escalation for patient safety concerns, complaints, and adverse experience reports Investigate and resolve complaints in a timely, thorough, and empathetic manner, documenting findings and outcomes with precision Identify when a patient situation requires urgent intervention and coordinate an appropriate response across CX and operations Ensure patients feel heard and supported throughout any complaint or escalation process Conduct & Risk Oversight Review flagged reports from internal stakeholders regarding the behavior or conduct of any patient-facing individual or team Assess whether conduct aligns with Solace's ethical guidelines and engagement standards, distinguishing conduct/trust issues from process-conformance issues Maintain accurate, confidential records of all investigations and outcomes Risk Monitoring & Pattern Analysis Monitor patient feedback, escalation data, and operational signals to identify emerging risk patterns before they become systemic Track complaint trends, root causes, and repeat issues; surface insights to CX leadership with recommended mitigations Contribute to risk reporting cadences and flag high-priority issues in real time Support the development of internal playbooks and response protocols for common risk scenarios Cross-Functional Partnership Act as a trusted point of contact for internal stakeholders (operations, clinical, product) who surface risk or safety concerns Partner with QA to distinguish systemic quality issues from individual trust and safety incidents, ensuring each is handled appropriately Contribute to policy and SOP updates that reduce risk and strengthen the patient-advocate relationship What You Bring to the Table Experience in trust and safety, patient advocacy, healthcare operations, compliance, or a related field A calm, methodical approach to high-stakes or sensitive situations. You don't rattle easily and you know how to de-escalate Strong investigative instincts: you ask the right questions, follow the evidence, and reach sound conclusions Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to document cases clearly and handle sensitive topics with discretion Familiarity with complaint management, incident review processes, or risk frameworks Comfort navigating ambiguity and making judgment calls when situations don't fit neatly into a playbook Collaborative by nature: you work well across functions and build trust quickly with stakeholders A deep commitment to patient welfare and a clear sense of what's at stake Applicants must be based in the United States. Up for the Challenge? We look forward to meeting you. Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com . Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

This role sits at the intersection of patient safety, advocate accountability, and operational risk. Ensure the team investigates and resolves complaints in a timely, thorough, and empathetic manner, with clear documentation standards Define criteria for urgent intervention and coordinate cross-functional response for the highest-risk situations Serve as final escalation point for patients or stakeholders when a case requires manager-level judgment Advocate Oversight & SOP Compliance Uphold the process by which advocate behavior, conduct, and quality concerns are reviewed Partner with QA and team leads to adjudicate cases requiring formal performance review or corrective action Own the integrity and confidentiality of investigation records and reporting Drive continuous improvement of SOPs and ethical guidelines based on case learnings Risk Strategy & Pattern Analysis Build and own risk monitoring practices across patient feedback, escalation data, and operational signals Identify systemic risk patterns and lead root-cause analysis, translating findings into concrete mitigations Own the risk reporting cadence to CX and cross-functional leadership, including prioritization of high-severity issues Lead development of internal playbooks and response protocols for known and emerging risk scenarios Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategy Act as the primary point of contact and thought partner for operations, clinical, product, and legal/compliance stakeholders on trust and integrity matters Partner with QA leadership to define how systemic quality issues are distinguished from individual trust and integrity incidents Represent Trust & Integrity in policy and SOP development, ensuring risk considerations are built into how Solace scales Contribute to org-wide risk and safety strategy as a subject matter expert What You Bring to the Table Experience managing or leading a team in trust and safety, patient advocacy, healthcare operations, compliance, or a related field A track record of building or scaling processes, SOPs, or playbooks in a high-stakes environment A calm, methodical approach to high-stakes or sensitive situations, with strong judgment under ambiguity Strong investigative instincts and the ability to coach others to develop the same Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting findings and recommendations to leadership Deep familiarity with complaint management, incident review processes, or risk frameworks Demonstrated ability to build trust quickly across functions, including with senior stakeholders A deep commitment to patient welfare and a clear sense of what's at stake Applicants must be based in the United States. title: Customer Care Analyst & Ops - CDI
description: Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous construisons l'infrastructure financière du monde de demain. Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l'ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Une reconnaissance qui nous place au niveau des acteurs réglementés de premier plan, et qui change en profondeur ce que nous construisons, et comment. Green-Got propose : Un compte de paiement associé à une carte pour payer et être payé au quotidien. Une gamme de placements financiers performants pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition. L'expérience membre est au cœur de ce modèle. C'est le socle sur lequel repose la confiance que nos membres nous accordent, et que l'équipe Customer Care entretient chaque jour. Green-Got en chiffres : 100 M€ de transactions traitées chaque mois ; 2,3 Md€ de transactions sécurisées depuis notre lancement ; 2 M€ de dons reversés à des projets de transition ; 4,8/5 sur Trustpilot ; 5 % de notre chiffre d'affaires pour soutenir directement des projets de terrain, en finançant directement la Fondation Green-Got. Le contexte : 📍 Locaux à Paris + télétravail, ouvert au full remote depuis ton pays de résidence ; 📄 CDI : contrat de 39h /semaine ; 💶 28–32K € selon profil ; 🗓 Prise de poste : au plus tôt. Chez Green-Got, le Customer Care est la voix de nos membres en interne, et la voix de Green-Got auprès d'eux, un rôle stratégique dans une institution financière qui grandit vite et qui doit tenir ses promesses 7 jours sur 7. Nos membres ont changé de dimension avec nous : Compte Premium, PER, compte commun, offre indépendant. Chaque nouveau produit génère de nouvelles questions, de nouvelles situations, de nouveaux défis. L'ouverture prochaine des services BtoB va encore élargir le périmètre. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime comprendre, qui sait garder son calme sous pression, et qui considère chaque échange comme une opportunité d'améliorer le produit, pas juste de fermer un ticket. Tu es à l'aise avec les gens et rigoureux sur le fond. Les deux à la fois. Vos missions Tes missions : Membre de l'équipe Customer Care, tu es le point de relais central entre nos membres et toutes les équipes de Green-Got : produit, tech, compliance, marketing, impact. Ton périmètre est vivant : il évolue avec nos lancements, nos besoins, et la trajectoire de Green-Got. Ta capacité à t'adapter, à prioriser et à garder un haut niveau de qualité dans tous les contextes est ce qui nous permettra de grandir sereinement. FRONT - Relation membre 50 % Premier point de contact : tu réponds à nos membres sur tous nos canaux, chat (90 %), email (8 %), téléphone (2 %), avec clarté, empathie et dans les délais. Expertise produit : tu connais Green-Got sur le bout des doigts. Tu accompagnes nos membres sur leurs comptes, leurs transactions, leurs questions, et tu trouves la bonne réponse après investigation. Gestion des nouvelles situations : tu identifies, qualifies et résous les cas inédits. Tu es garant de la qualité du premier contact. RUN - Support opérationnel 35 % Voix des membres en interne : tu collectes, structures et remontes les besoins, frustrations et suggestions aux équipes produit, tech, marketing. Amélioration continue : tu optimises les process existants, challenges les workflows, et maintiens notre documentation (FAQ, process) à jour à chaque évolution produit. Suivi des incidents : tu identifies les bugs, les remontes aux équipes concernées et en assures le suivi jusqu'à résolution. Recette fonctionnelle : tu participes aux phases de test des nouvelles fonctionnalités avant mise en production. BUILD - Gestion de projet 15 % Initiative et ownership : tu identifies des leviers d'amélioration de l'expérience membre, tu définis des indicateurs, proposes et mets en œuvre des actions concrètes. Pilotage : tu mets en place les outils et routines nécessaires au suivi de tes projets et en garantis le résultat. Vos compétences L'empathie, la rigueur dans l'exécution et la capacité à rester serein quand ça s'accélère sont pour toi des réflexes naturels. Tu comprends que la qualité du service est un engagement, pas une intention. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui en est convaincu. Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite. Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème. Rigueur et organisation : tu priorises, tu documentes, tu assures un suivi sans failles. Aisance rédactionnelle : ton orthographe est irréprochable, tu adaptes le ton à chaque interlocuteur. La précision est ta signature. Curiosité analytique : tu aimes comprendre pourquoi une situation se produit, pas juste la résoudre. Tu identifies les patterns et tu les remontes. Gestion du stress : tu gardes ton calme quand la situation l'exige. La pression ne dégrade pas ta qualité. Anglais opérationnel : tu lis, tu réponds, tu échanges sans chercher tes mots. Nous avons des membres non francophones et nous en aurons davantage. Sensibilité à l'impact : la transition environnementale a une réelle importance pour toi. Tu comprends les enjeux et tu portes la mission de Green-Got avec sincérité. Appétence pour les outils numériques : Intercom, Notion, Slack, Aircall, et une vraie curiosité pour l'IA et l'automatisation appliquées au service client. Formation : BTS, IUT, école de commerce, IAE ou toute formation en lien avec la relation client. Une première expérience en care ou service client est un vrai plus. Avantages Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons une expérience membre de premier plan , avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant. Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction. Un rôle avec de l'impact réel : dans un secteur en pleine transformation, au contact direct de nos membres chaque jour. De vraies responsabilités : tu n'exécutes pas, tu contribues. Tes remontées terrain façonnent le produit. Apprentissage : aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet, dans un environnement réglementaire de premier plan. Évolution : les profils les plus engagés grandissent avec nous et prennent des responsabilités clés. Flexibilité : remote possible depuis chez toi et partout en Europe. Équipe : ambitieuse, exigeante, déterminée, et qui passe de bons moments ensemble. Le package : CDI remote ou Paris. Rémunération : 28 - 32k, selon profil. BSPCE. Mutuelle santé Alan. Une journée d’équipe tous les semestres. Déroulement des entretiens : Envoie-nous ton CV et tout autre élément qui nous aide à jauger tes compétences et ta motivation. Call rapide pour faire connaissance. Si ça matche, on t’envoie un Business Case à préparer. Entretien en visio avec Vincent (Customer Care Manager) pour analyser le Business Case et te tester / te connaitre. Échange avec un ou plusieurs membres de l’équipe pour le fit culturel. Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations). Entretien avec Andréa (CEO). Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer ! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD. Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus. Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts Who You Are Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. About the role Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives. Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API. ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data. Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure. Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become. What you need to succeed Data infrastructure at scale: You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more. Physical-world data: You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous systems and know what embodied AI teams need from data and where it breaks. Sensitive data: You know how to handle personal and confidential data safely. Experience with regulated data is a plus. Technical leadership: You make architectural decisions, explain them clearly and raise the engineering bar as the team grows. Hands-on Builder: You have taken a product, platform or open-source project from 0 to 1 that others relied on, and you still write code and own the critical paths. Founder mindset: You care about the outcome, not the title. You form strong views, test them quickly and are comfortable owning technical, product and operational problems. Location: Paris preferred. English required; French is a plus. Please note: As a co-founder, you take a real stake in what we build. The compensation is a founder salary, and your upside grows with the company through your equity. Come build the infrastructure between AI and the world's data with us! You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs) You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …) You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs. Multi-physics isn’t just theory to you; you use thermal, electrical, and mechanical simulations to see the whole system clearly. You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams. You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand. Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation. Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities. Why Join Us: You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation. You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment. In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics. You can count on a motivating total rewards package. Flexible ways of working. title: Senior Data Engineer - Terminal.exe
description: Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on. What you get A salary between €85,000-€99,000 per year inclusive of holiday allowance, based on your experience. €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then. Fully remote, within Europe. Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. About us All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. About Terminal.exe Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide. What the job looks like You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets. Concretely, you will work on: ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging. A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi) Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers. What you bring Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing. Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store. Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint. Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry. Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain. We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. title: Senior Writer, Borrowing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£68,000 - £88,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> | 12 month fixed term contract</p> <p> </p> <p>Every word we write matters. From what’s in the app, to job ads (like this one), to error messages, to emails, to internal policies, to… you get the idea.</p> <p>The Writing team isn’t responsible for writing every word though – we’re here to level up Monzo’s writing overall. We have a well-established tone of voice, and people here really care about making sure all our writing is consistently good and works hard for customers. It’ll be your job to keep that quality up through the writing you do. But you’ll also be a champion for great writing by proving the difference it makes, and helping other people to improve their own writing skills.</p> <p>Our never-ending reason to exist is to improve the overall quality of writing at Monzo. That means a culture where care for language is the norm. Everyone, in every role, should understand how important it is to write in a clear, empathetic way, and they should all have the skills to do it. The outcome of that will be world-leading writing for customers. They’ll trust us because our writing is clear, effective and works hard for them.</p> <p>You’ll get together with the other writers pretty regularly to review and showcase work, collect feedback and insights from one another and generally just raise the bar for words at Monzo. And as we hinted at already, you’ll live and breathe our tone of voice, which is propped up by 3 guiding principles: straightforward kindness, everyday magic and warm wit. </p> <p><strong>You’ll be covering our Borrowing Writer while they’re on caregiver leave</strong></p> <p>This is a 12-month fixed term contract covering for our Writer who’s based in the Borrowing collective. That means you’ll be focused on supporting teams working on things like loans, credit cards, overdrafts and other borrowing and credit related projects.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with cross-functional squads of engineers, designers, marketers, researchers and so on to make it an amazing experience for existing customers, and bring new people on board.</p> <p><strong>A typical day could see you</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>collaborating with a Product Designer on some in-app screens </li> <li>collaborating with a Product Marketer on positioning and building messaging toolkits for use across web, growth marketing or CRM</li> <li>sitting in on user research sessions led by the Research team</li> <li>writing error messages with input from engineers</li> <li>editing legal wording alongside our in-house lawyers </li> </ul> <p><strong>Your home will be in Writing<br><br></strong>Alongside the work you do in Borrowing, you’ll contribute to the Writing discipline. We’re always working on new resources, training and processes to make writing easier for everyone at Monzo.</p> <p>Writing is part of the wider Marketing team but this role isn’t only about marketing. In fact, that’s a small part of the job. Your remit will be to improve the quality of the writing that touches your part of the business, inside Monzo and out.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>you understand borrowing and credit products well</li> <li>you’re a dab hand at ‘content design’, ‘UX writing’, ‘product writing’</li> <li>you’re allergic to useless jargon and over-complicated language </li> <li>you know how to use data and research to guide your approach </li> <li>you’re okay bouncing between tasks on a daily basis </li> <li>you’re comfortable questioning a brief and helping people understand why your approach is the right one </li> <li>you’ve done some training or coaching to help other people improve their writing, but this one’s not essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This isn’t for you if</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>it’s your first writing job – sorry, but we need someone to hit the ground running </li> <li>you’re a journalist or ad writer</li> <li>you’re only really excited by brand and marketing stuff – that isn’t the focus of this role</li> <li>you prefer to spend most of your time working solo – writing here is a team sport and you’ll need to collaborate with everyone across the company </li> <li>you like lots of top-down direction – you’ll be expected to decide which challenges you tackle with your team, and how to tackle them. </li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll get</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>the chance to shape the role around what’s good for you, and us </li> <li>very flexible working – we care about what you do, not the minutes you work or where you do it (we love to see our teammates in the office but you don’t have to come in if you don’t want to) </li> <li>a whole load of benefits, including a personal training budget, health insurance, generous caregiving leave and more you can read about here: https://monzo.com/careers/ </li> </ul> <p><strong>Please make sure you give us both a CV and a cover letter. </strong>This is a writing job after all; you should want to show us what you can do. A cover letter also helps us understand why you want the job vs a CV which often just tells us why you might be able to do the job.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages (not including a recruiter call).</p> <ol> <li>Initial call with the Hiring Manager (30mins) </li> <li>Take home task (to be submitted within 7 days) </li> <li>A pair of interviews via Google Meet (each interview lasting up to 60 minutes)</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>£68,000 - £88,800 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> <strong>here </strong></a></li> </ul> <p><strong>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</strong> <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Business Development Manager
description: Role highlights: Business Development Manager Location: Any Australian state capital city, Canberra preferred Department: Data Sales Reports to: Data Sales Director, Australia & New Zealand Employment type: Permanent Workplace model: Remote first, frequent travel expected Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) Why this role matters: As a Business Development Manager, you’ll bridge the gap between ICEYE ’s world-leading ISR satellite capability and the people who use space-based geospatial intelligence at the sharp end of Australian and New Zealand (ANZ) defence and national security. You will open doors, build credibility, and ensure the ANZ’s most important intelligence users understand what makes ICEYE genuinely different. ICEYE is not the traditional defence prime. ICEYE is a different proposition entirely. We are one of the world’s fastest-growing space companies, and we are only at the beginning of what we intend to build in the ANZ region – not only in defence and intelligence, but across a range of industry verticals where geospatial intelligence is a critical need. From day one, you'll own the full sales cycle for Data Sales business clients — identifying opportunities, shaping deals, and closing multi-year contracts — with the autonomy to move at pace and build the strategic relationships that expand ICEYE's presence across the ANZ market. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation, we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system as both a data and managed service business. ICEYE serves customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance, mining, maritime and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. ICEYE is expanding both satellite technological capabilities and its advanced data processing product suite, and over time the range and breadth of data products will increase. This is a learning role that will span a range of industries and use cases. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1200 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Your day-to-day responsibilities Report to the ANZ Data Sales team Build and maintain a trusted network of Intelligence and GEOINT practitioners across ANZ defence, intelligence and other industries: attending user engagements, demonstrations, and briefings to represent ICEYE credibly at the working level and stay close to user needs, priorities, and procurement timelines. Advise internal ICEYE teams (Missions, Data and Solutions) on how ANZ military and intelligence users consume intelligence imagery, what tradecraft matters, and how to frame ICEYE’s products in language that resonates with analysts and collection managers. Identify key decision-influencers across ANZ target organisations, and plan, host, and lead ICEYE engagements, from technical demonstrations to senior roundtables, to build trust and advance ICEYE’s standing. Participate as needed in ANZ military exercises that incorporate ICEYE capability, representing ICEYE at the operational level and capturing lessons that feed back into product and service development. Maintain strong CRM discipline and provide clear market intelligence to support business planning and decision-making. Produce responses to RFPs, proposals, inbound enquiries, assist with promotional material and attend relevant industry events. What we’re looking for Must haves: An established personal network within the ANZ geospatial community at the working and mid-senior level (people who will take your call) 5+ years of strategic sales or enterprise business development experience in the aerospace, defence, space, ISR, earth observation, or related government technology sector. Proven experience selling to ANZ government, defence, or public sector organisations, with an existing network you can activate from day one Strong understanding of earth observation, ISR, or satellite-based capabilities, ideally including SAR. Proven ability to run complex sales cycles, including lead qualification, opportunity development, capture planning, stakeholder mapping, and deal closure. Willingness to travel as required, primarily across the ANZ region and to Europe. Nice to haves: Currently serving as a reservist, or recently transitioned from active duty within the last five years. Familiarity with SAR (and other ISR) geospatial satellite products, or experience working with commercial SAR (and other ISR) providers. Experience using Salesforce or another CRM. Sales training in Miller Heiman, Korn Ferry, Shipley, or a similar methodology Holds current ANZ Defence Security Clearance Application Process Recruiter interview Hiring Manager Interview Peer interview(s) VP interview Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win. How We Work (Our Values) Make the impossible possible : We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way. Be curious : Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions. See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others. Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions. Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift. Have fun : What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins. Benefits Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process. Salary range is dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table. We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help. Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com .

title: Data Analytics & Revenue Reporting Specialist
description: Company Overview LevelUp is a specialist agency that provides outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We have a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients. Position Overview We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and data-driven Data Analytics & Revenue Reporting Specialist to drive data-informed financial strategies, ensure reporting continuity, and optimize revenue performance. In this critical role, you will be responsible for keeping key recurring revenue metrics—such as Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)—accurate, aligned, and timely. You will also directly support high-impact transformation projects. As a primary steward of revenue data, you will deep dive into complex datasets, construct dashboards, reconcile financial data across disparate platforms, and translate technical findings into clear, strategic narratives for leadership and cross-functional teams. Role Details • Schedule: Aligned with US Central Time (9:00 PM – 6:00 AM PH Time). • Commitment: Initially a specialized part-time role requiring focused dedication (6 to 8 hours per day during the first week of each month for the monthly close/reporting cycle, with full-time work required during the initial 3–4 weeks for onboarding). There is a potential pathway to transition into a full-time position as projects scale. Reference: 2642-123348 Responsibilities ARR & MRR Reporting: Monitor, analyze, and report on core SaaS revenue metrics including new, upgrade, downgrade, expansion, and churned ARR/MRR during key financial reporting windows. Dashboard Development & Maintenance: Build, enhance, and maintain intuitive dashboards and reports using Looker Studio, Excel, and Google Sheets to visualize trends and KPIs for executive stakeholders. Data Reconciliation & Validation: Validate data consistency and identify discrepancies across enterprise platforms, including Salesforce (CRM), NetSuite (ERP), Stripe (Billing), and BigQuery (Data Warehouse). Data QA & Troubleshooting: Quality assure upstream and downstream data feeds, perform root-cause analysis on reporting discrepancies, and ensure data integrity across the entire analytics pipeline. Strategic Project Support: Actively support ongoing transformation projects, assisting in defining metrics, refining data models, and establishing automated reporting workflows. Financial Modeling & Forecasting: Assist finance and revenue operations in creating and updating forecasting models, scenario analyses, and customer retention/churn analytics. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Finance, Sales, Strategy, and Data Engineering teams to align on metric definitions, reporting cadences, and data taxonomy. Insight Translation: Translate intricate, multi-layered financial datasets into clear, actionable recommendations and narratives for non-technical leadership and stakeholders. Experience & Requirements Professional Experience: 2–3+ years of professional experience in revenue analytics, financial data analysis, business intelligence, or SaaS revenue reporting. SaaS Metric Mastery: Thorough understanding of SaaS subscription models and key financial metrics (ARR, MRR, Net Revenue Retention, Gross Retention, Churn, ARPU, LTV, CAC). Advanced SQL & Big Data: Strong proficiency in writing complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze datasets stored in data warehouses such as Google BigQuery. Spreadsheet Proficiency: Expert knowledge of Excel and Google Sheets, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and scenario testing. BI & Visualization: Demonstrated experience constructing, maintaining, and troubleshooting dashboards in Looker, Looker Studio, or comparable BI tools. Data Reconciliation & Systems: Proven ability to validate and reconcile cross-system data involving Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, and modern enterprise data pipelines (ETL/ELT). Technical Familiarity: Hands-on familiarity with Stripe billing configurations and transaction structures, as well as direct working experience with NetSuite ERP module reporting is a strong plus. Communication Skills: Professional-level written and verbal English communication skills, with a track record of clearly conveying data insights to stakeholders. Business Acumen: Understanding of GTM (Go-To-Market) strategies, customer lifecycle management, and enterprise financial planning is nice to have. Compensation Additional Information
