value.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate with partners, Sales Development, Solution Architecture, and Digital Marketing to develop account strategies and win new business.</li> <li value="6">Achieve monthly and quarterly targets for new customer count and booked annual recurring revenue.</li> <li value="7">Analyze wins and losses, share lessons and prospect feedback with Sales, Marketing, technical teams, and Product Development, contribute product ideas to the public issue tracker, and document improvements in the sales handbook.</li> <li value="8">Build your knowledge of GitLab's product, market, and related technologies, and acquire industry-standard certifications to strengthen your technical credibility.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in information technology through sales, technical consulting, customer success, marketing, or customer service, with a demonstrated record of outbound prospecting, securing meetings, winning business, and building business cases for new accounts.</li> <li value="2">Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including discovery, identifying customer pain points, presenting solutions, negotiating, and closing.</li> <li value="3">Experience taking ownership of prospecting, following up through setbacks, and delivering results while working in accordance with GitLab's values.</li> <li value="4">Experience with modern sales tools, including Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo or Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, and 6sense.</li> <li value="5">A basic understanding of through training, reading, and mentorship.</li> <li value="7">The ability to travel when needed and comply with GitLab's travel policy.</li> <li value="8">Preferred: an understanding of business-to-business software, open source software, and the developer product space.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We work with Sales Development, Solution Architecture, Digital Marketing, title: Creative Designer (m/w/d)
description: Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt. Wer wir sind NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt. Warum diese Rolle Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt. Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop. Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt. Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen. KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist. Aufgaben Performance Creatives Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound. Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter. Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein. Social Media & Organic Content Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform. Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen. Shop, Amazon & Brand Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle Bannerbilder, Kampagnen-Visuals und Shopbilder – von Landingpage-Headern. Du hältst unser visuelles Erscheinungsbild über alle Kanäle konsistent und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter. Produktion & Workflow Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert. Qualifikation Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound. Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand. Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static. Das ist uns außerdem wichtig Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur. Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy. Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden. Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets. Das zählt für uns am meisten Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil. Nice to have Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs). Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings. Kenntnisse in Shopify (Bildformate, Theme-Assets) oder Amazon-Bildrichtlinien. Erfahrung im Fitness- oder Sport-Umfeld. Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt unter „außerdem wichtig“? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert dein Portfolio und wie du denkst – nicht, ob du jede Zeile abhaken kannst. Benefits DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Zu Shootings triffst du das Team vor Ort – der Rest läuft von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest. Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware und den Tools, die du brauchst, erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst das visuelle Erscheinungsbild einer wachsenden Marke und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Inhouse-Creative-Produktion aktiv mit – inklusive KI-basierter Workflows. Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke. Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Kontakt: Josephine Steuer Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dresscode und wir duzen uns einfach. Der Einfachheit halber verwenden wir im Text eine Sprachform, schließen damit aber ausdrücklich alle Menschen ein. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Shopify Manager (m/w/d) - Conversion, Funnel & Shop-Entwicklung

Kurze Entscheidungswege und starke Startup-Kultur mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf dich zugeschnitten. Although we don’t require managers to contribute to code directly, we do expect you to participate in design discussions and to be involved in setting the bar for engineering quality and best practices. Delivery & Roadmap - Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones. - Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on. - Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead. - Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO. - Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership. Incident Commander - Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up. - Lead blameless post-incident reviews YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems. - Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams. - Have managed engineering teams at a cloud, SaaS, or developer tools company. - Experience with developer tools or databases, plus if that includes both SQLite and Postgres ecosystems. - Strong technical credibility in backend and database systems: APIs, auth, and Postgres access control (roles, grants, RLS) etc. - Has led a team shipping a developer facing API or platform product from early stage to production. - Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones. - Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for. - Build psychological safety and a feedback culture: you give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same. - Operate as a multiplier. Focused on helping individuals achieve more than they could alone, not on being the best technical voice in the room. - Coach rather than direct. Remove blockers, connect people to context and resources, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done. - Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations and how you navigated them. - Are comfortable with ambiguity and capable of building structure where there isn't much. - Communicate clearly and write well. You're default async, default written, set context proactively, and surface risks early. - Are collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable. You thrive working with high-autonomy, senior ICs who have strong technical opinions and don't need to be the smartest person in the room. - Are comfortable with aggressive scoping and eval driven development. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Product Designer
description: Location: UK, central Europe, and Latin America Remote | Full-time Compensation: Competitive Compensation Our client is seeking an experienced, full-time Product Designer to shape the core user experience of their trend intelligence platform. In this role, the designer will play a key part in designing and evolving the platform’s primary dashboard—where brand innovation teams, product marketers, social media teams, and agencies explore trends, generate reports, and interact with LLM-powered features. As the platform rebuilds around LLM-driven capabilities, the successful candidate will be responsible for defining not just how features look, but how complex data and AI experiences should function. The primary focus is transforming dense, aggregated trend data into clear, intuitive, and actionable insights. This position joins a close-knit Frontend & UX team reporting directly to the Frontend Lead. The role is 100% remote and open to candidates based between US Central Time (UTC−6) and Central European Time (UTC+1). Candidates must be available during core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (2:00 PM–5:00 PM UK / 3:00 PM–6:00 PM CET). Key Responsibilities End-to-End Product Design: Own features from initial framing to final launch, partnering closely with engineering leadership to deliver written proposals, user flows, prototypes, and Figma specifications. Problem Identification & Solution Design: Independently identify user pain points through customer calls, interviews, user feedback, and usage data to build compelling product proposals. AI & LLM Experience Design: Define user interactions for AI features (chat, automated reports, inline summaries), establish standards for insight attribution and uncertainty handling, and help refine the voice and structure of AI-generated content. Design System Management: Own the principles and Figma library for the design system, partnering with frontend engineers to align with the React component library and establish robust data visualization and AI UX patterns. UX Quality & Feedback Loops: Co-own product metrics, user feedback tracking, and quality evaluation rubrics for LLM outputs alongside the Frontend Lead. Note: This position focuses strictly on product/UI/UX design. It does not involve writing production code, managing brand/marketing assets, or overseeing back-end API integrations. Requirements Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of product design experience, ideally owning features end-to-end within a B2B or SaaS platform. Product Thinking: Strong strategic perspective with a proven ability to define what to build and why , backed by a portfolio demonstrating strong problem-framing abilities. Domain Focus: Experience designing data-heavy products, such as dashboards, analytics platforms, or reporting tools. Design Systems: Proven track record of working within and contributing to scalable design component libraries. Tools & AI Integration: High proficiency in Figma, with active integration of AI tools into day-to-day design workflows and a strong curiosity regarding LLM product experiences. Communication: Excellent written English skills, capable of producing clear proposals and documentation in an asynchronous remote environment. Schedule: Location within UTC−6 to UTC+1, with full availability during core collaboration hours (9:00 AM–12:00 PM EST). Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have) Experience as the founding or primary designer on a product team. Hands-on experience building or evolving design systems adopted by engineering teams. Direct experience designing AI features or creating evaluation rubrics for LLM output quality. Expertise in advanced data visualization patterns. Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food & beverage, or marketing intelligence platforms. Capability to build rapid functional prototypes using AI-assisted tools to evaluate live outputs. Benefits Competitive compensation package tailored to experience. Collaborative, high-impact environment with direct influence on core product direction. Opportunity to work closely alongside senior design leadership. Flexible starting timeline (target start date in January, with early onboarding available). Interview Process Initial Video Screening: A brief introductory video conversation to discuss background, expectations, and role fit. Personality Assessment: An online assessment to evaluate working style and team dynamics. Design Leadership Interview: A 30-minute introductory chat with the Lead Designer. Screen-Recorded Case Study: A flexible, practical exercise (details currently being finalized) to demonstrate hands-on design methodology and execution. Final Interview: A concluding conversation with key stakeholders to review results and align on next steps. title: Prudential Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £64,000 - £80,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>Our Prudential Risk team⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Prudential Risk team is expanding, and we are searching for a Manager to join our 2nd Line Prudential Risk Oversight team. You will be part of the broader 2LoD Risk and Compliance department here at Monzo.</p> <p>This represents a fantastic chance to contribute to a scaling bank with high aspirations. By joining the Prudential Risk Oversight team, you will champion our value to "grow Monzo safely." Your focus will involve collaborating with 1st Line Financial Risk to provide expert second-line oversight of their key prudential regulatory deliverables including the ICAAP, Recovery Plan and Resolution Planning. The role will also interpret and assess the impact of regulatory change and support the review and development of financial models used for financial forecasting, capital planning, and stress testing. </p> <p>Ideally you will have had experiences producing or reviewing regulatory submissions, the role will support the Senior Manager overseeing the ICAAP, Recovery Plan and across all RAF barriers, with a key focus on the financial risk barriers. You will work alongside the first line to provide in-flight review and challenge and complete independent assurance reviews on discrete areas of focus. Part of the role will involve reviewing stress testing outputs from Anaplan for the ICAAP, Recovery Planning and Valuation In Resolution, it would be beneficial to have experience analysing large data sets in excel/g-sheets.    </p> <p>A successful applicant will bring hands-on experience of interpreting and challenging capital prudential regulations and have the ability to develop and build strong working relationships with colleagues across the three lines of defence. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Supporting the oversight of key regulatory deliverable </strong>and enhancement plans in line with Monzo’s approach, regulatory expectations and industry best practices. <strong> </strong></li> <li><strong>Identification and interpretation </strong>of regulatory rules, providing oversight and challenge and ensuring these are applied correctly. </li> <li><strong>Support the production of reports and options </strong>on Monzo’s financial position and controls framework for key risk committees and the Board, making recommendations for ensuring controls are effective and prudential regulatory compliance. </li> <li><strong>Work alongside the Group Risk team </strong>to ensure Monzo’s Group Financial Risk Framework and Financial Projections Framework are adhered to, and that suitable controls and policies are in place. </li> <li><strong>Review financial models</strong> used for financial forecasting, capital planning and stress testing (including the ICAAP and Recovery Plan), owned by the 1st Line of Defence, within G-Sheets and Anaplan, including running sensitivity analysis and forming insights, observations and recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Conduct discrete pieces of assurance</strong> to support the strengthening of risk and controls in Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Develop strong relationships</strong> with colleagues to support the embedding of prudential risk management activity.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You have relevant prudential experience</strong> gained within a bank, a consultancy, or a regulatory body.</li> <li><strong>You have a genuine desire to learn and grow</strong>, and you are excited about building enhanced 2LoD oversight within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.</li> <li><strong>Have in-depth knowledge/experience</strong> of the relevant regulatory requirements, specifically in relation to capital, recovery planning and resolution, and the ability to interpret what that means for the relatively unique circumstances of our bank.</li> <li><strong>Have advanced Excel/ G-sheet skills</strong> and experience of building or reviewing financial models to support financial forecasting or capital planning, preferably relevant to a retail bank. </li> <li><strong>Are interested in analysing data</strong>, performing analysis and understanding the impact on our bank to form risk insights.</li> <li><strong>You are a good relationship builder</strong> who can develop productive working connections with 1LoD stakeholders across all levels of the business, whilst maintaining the ability to provide robust, informed challenge and review to ensure our safe growth.</li> <li><strong>Strong written and verbal</strong> communication style.</li> </ul> <p><em>We are looking for someone who has a strong foundation in several of these areas, with plenty of room and support to learn and develop the rest within the role.</em></p> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
description: About Huzzle Labs Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance. About the Role Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance. This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Responsibilities Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books. Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly. Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo. Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears. Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.” Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria. Requirements At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax and job costing. Excellent written English and precision with numbers. Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria. Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension. Example Assignment For a client deal room covering a small business with incomplete and inconsistent books, you would: Review the files and select the relevant documents, such as bank statements, ledgers, invoices and ageing reports. Write a prompt as the business owner or controller would, asking for a reconciliation and the adjusting entries needed to close the month. Run the prompt against a frontier AI model and check the spreadsheet or journal entry schedule line by line. If the model completes the task correctly, increase the difficulty, for example, by adding a customer deposit, a timing difference or a sales tax complication, until it fails. Write the rubric, such as “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue,” so another reviewer can grade any answer without repeating the work. Confidentiality An NDA must be signed before the engagement begins. Benefits Compensation: $60 - $90 USD / hour Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Partnerships Manager, Ecosystem
description: PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER, ECOSYSTEM ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform built for developers. We provide a complete backend solution — Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search — all deeply integrated and designed to scale. Millions of developers build on Supabase. We're remote-first, async-native, and we move fast. ABOUT THE ROLE We're in the early days of building our partner marketplace program, and this role is foundational to it. You'll help lay the groundwork for what this program becomes — starting by owning two critical pieces: deep account management for our top marketplace and referral partners, and vetting the intake of new partnership requests. You'll take a focused set of high-priority partners and go deep — building the co-marketing and co-sell motion that drives real user growth — while also serving as the first filter for new partner opportunities coming into the pipeline. What you'll do Partner Account Management - Develop and execute co-marketing and co-sell strategies with each partner to drive user growth - Own day-to-day relationship management for a focused portfolio of top marketplace and referral partners - Report on partner performance and progress — adoption, attribution, revenue impact — to internal stakeholders - Coordinate integration support and ensure partners have what they need to succeed post-signature Partner Intake & Routing - Vet incoming partnership requests and evaluate fit against our partnership criteria - Ensure new partners are routed and bucketed correctly across the right internal programs - Own partner onboarding — getting new partners set up and moving smoothly from signed agreement to active partner - Flag high-potential opportunities for further evaluation or escalation Who you are - 5-10 years of experience in Partnerships, referral marketing, or channel sales - Experience helping build a marketplace from 0 to 1 - Domain expertise spanning PLG motions, integrations, marketplace ecosystems, and devtools/database companies — you understand how developers evaluate and adopt infrastructure tooling, and you've seen how partner programs operate from the inside - Track record of driving co-marketing and co-sell campaigns that delivered measurable results, with a solid grasp of attribution - Fluent working across modern tool stacks — Notion, Linear, Slack, Claude, and similar systems — as part of your daily workflow Nice to have - Prior experience at an early-stage startup - Hands-on experience building with Supabase or AI-powered tools (Lovable, Bolt, Figma, v0, etc.) We Offer - 100% remote, no location-based salary adjustments - Autonomous work environment - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental — 100% for employees, 80% for dependents - Tech Allowance + Annual Education Allowance - Annual company off-sites WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. title: Growth Marketer, Creators & Channels
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Creator and UGC content is only getting bigger as a growth channel for developer tools, and right now Supabase reaches it mostly at arm's length, through agencies that own the actual relationships with creators. This role exists to change that: bring our creator/influencer program fully in-house, own those relationships directly, and grow the program into a multi-million-dollar channel. A good marker of success looks like a roster of around 50 active creators within the first year — at which point we take what worked and go find the next channel to unlock the same way. This is a growth and marketing role first, not a DevRel or engineering-adjacent one — we're optimizing less for technical depth and more for someone outgoing enough that creators want to work with them directly, creative enough to keep testing new formats and strategies, and operationally strong enough to run the budgets and reporting behind it. The work is currently split on an interim basis across a couple of people on the marketing team; this role is being created to own it end to end. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Source, recruit, and manage direct relationships with content creators (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) - Design and run creator campaigns end to end - Find and test new acquisition channels and strategies — lots of small experiments, doubling down on what works - Operationalize and report on these programs: budgets, tracking, results - Grow with the role: the remit could develop into owning all content from a growth perspective, beyond creators and UGC YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - 3+ years in growth, partnerships or creator marketing at a dev tool, SaaS or consumer tech company - Track record of launching channels from zero — and turning winners into repeatable programs - Outgoing relationship-builder creators genuinely want to work with - Strong operator. Comfortable with spreadsheets. - Ideally already doing a version of this somewhere scrappier or more startup — someone thriving at a smaller company is a better signal here than someone comfortable (but not standout) at a big-name platform WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description: Who we are Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to turn Yubo's brand ambition into brilliant, effective marketing, from major campaign moments to paid and owned-channel activity, and the smaller tests that help us learn what works. Reporting to the Director of Brand & Communications, you will translate Yubo's brand strategy into an executable US marketing programme. You will lead integrated brand campaigns, own campaign and paid-media planning and management, and build and manage influencer capabilities. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and execution. You will challenge plans constructively, make recommendations grounded in insight and data, and work closely with Creative, PR, Product, UA, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal to deliver marketing that builds the brand and drives growth. The role will focus on the US first, with scope to contribute to expansion into new markets as Yubo's marketing activity grows. This is a freelance position on a 6-month contract, with a target start of Q4 2026. Your responsibilites Turn strategic priorities into impactful marketing activity Lead the development and execution of Yubo's priority brand campaigns in the US, from insight and strategy through briefing, delivery, optimisation and reporting. Translate Yubo's positioning, audience priorities and seasonal moments into cultural marketing activity that earns attention amongst Gen Z. Develop integrated channel plans across paid, earned and owned activity, working closely with PR and Creative to ensure every channel plays a clear role. Own campaign budget planning and day-to-day management, partnering closely with UA on paid-media strategy and optimisation. Explore new, less traditional ways for Yubo to reach and engage people, challenging default channel choices and designing approaches that make marketing work harder. Establish brand marketing operations and measurement Establish effective working rhythms across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data, from briefing and approvals to reporting and learning. Work closely with Data and UA to analyse performance and make clear, evidence-based optimisation recommendations. Build clear measurement plans so every campaign, test and experiment informs future investment and potential expansion into new markets. Identify, recommend and deliver smaller tests and experiments that help Yubo learn quickly and improve future investment. Build influencer, social and community activity Build the plans, operating models and internal capability needed to deliver consistently strong influencer activity and integrate it into wider campaign plans. Manage influencer agency relationships, negotiating cost-effective partnership models that maximise impact and effectiveness. Who you are You are an experienced brand marketer with strong consumer instincts and a genuine interest in youth culture. You know how to turn a positioning and a business objective into a campaign people notice, and how to turn campaign results into smarter decisions next time. You are as comfortable building a strategic recommendation as you are writing a brief, reviewing creative, shaping a media plan, interrogating performance data or getting into the practical detail needed to make work happen. You don't wait for perfect information or a fully formed process; you create clarity, bring people together and move work forward. You will bring: A breadth of experience in brand and integrated marketing, ideally in a high-growth tech, consumer app, entertainment, lifestyle or youth-culture business. A track record of developing and delivering integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, working closely with cross-functional partners. An understanding of the US market and how 18–24-year-olds engage with brands, culture and social platforms. Experience owning campaign and paid-media planning and management, ideally in close partnership with performance marketing, creative and comms teams. Confidence analysing campaign performance and translating data into clear optimisation and investment recommendations. Experience working closely with creative teams to develop strong campaign platforms, briefs and work that is both strategically sharp and creatively ambitious. A curiosity for less traditional channels, partnerships and approaches, with the creativity to test new ways of reaching people and maximise earned attention above what we buy. A proactive, autonomous and highly collaborative working style. Within a month, you will Get up to speed on Yubo's brand, product, US market and audience. Meet your key stakeholders across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data. Review current campaign activity, budgets and ways of working. Start shaping the US marketing calendar and briefs with the Director of Brand & Communications. Within 3 months, you will Be leading delivery of Yubo's US campaigns, with briefs, channel plans and budgets in place. Have established the operating model between Brand, UA, Creative, PR, Product and Data. Be building the campaign measurement framework. Have started shaping Yubo's influencer marketing approach, including early agency conversations. Within 6 months, you will Have delivered Yubo's priority US brand campaigns end to end, from strategy through reporting. Have embedded the cross-functional operating model and measurement framework. Have established influencer marketing at Yubo, with agency partnerships operating. Have delivered key tests and experiments, with recommendations to inform 2027 priorities. The recruitment process First call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition A technical test with Alex, our Brand Director Our approach to privacy & safety As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts. Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact. Here’s how we live our mission every day: Y ou own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter U nconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better B e Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward O ne team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you. Enjoy Top-notch Benefits Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits: Cool Workplace : enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options Team Activities : participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities Family-Friendly : we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies Wellness Programs : benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Director, EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) or Barcelona, Spain (Hybrid) </p> <h3><strong>Engineering at Monzo</strong></h3> <p>Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.</p> <p>The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.</p> <p>Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.</p> <p>As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.</p> <p>Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.</p> <p>This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll work on</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.</li> <li>Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.</li> <li>Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.</li> <li>Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.</li> <li>Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.</li> <li>Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.</li> <li>Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.</li> <li>Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.</li> <li>Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You should apply if</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.</li> <li>You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.</li> <li>You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.</li> <li>You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.</li> <li>You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.</li> <li>You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.</li> <li>You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The interview process</strong></h3> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages: </p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage</strong> - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.</li> </ol> <p>At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.<br><br></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <h3><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h3> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas for the UK (not Spain)</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 ( a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

workflows and evaluation methods.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead backend features from early product discussions through technical design, implementation, rollout, and post-launch learning.</li> <li>Build the flows, application programming interfaces, and data models behind agent-generated work items, implementation plans, durable specifications, and mergeable code.</li> <li>Develop evaluation and benchmarking systems that measure workflow quality, token cost, and success rate.</li> <li>Use Ruby on Rails and Python to build reliable production systems, with PostgreSQL, GraphQL, representational state transfer, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.</li> <li>Collaborate In your first year, you'll focus on building trusted relationships and delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own a broad book of Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.</li> <li value="2">Manage the full sales cycle for Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.</li> <li value="3">Articulate the value of GitLab's DevSecOps platform and its artificial intelligence capabilities to Mid-Market prospects and customers, tailoring messaging to their business and technical needs.</li> <li value="4">Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent prospecting, qualification, and advancement of opportunities, using a structured sales process to support your pipeline and revenue goals.</li> <li value="5">Document buying criteria, decision processes, next steps, and key stakeholders to run disciplined, well-orchestrated sales cycles.</li> <li value="6">Collaborate with sales development, customer success, renewals, marketing, technical teams, and partners to deliver a cohesive pre- and post-sales experience, co-sell and close opportunities, and expand GitLab’s footprint while delivering added value for customers.</li> <li value="7">Support customer adoption of GitLab solutions, proactively work to reduce churn and contraction, and participate in quarterly forecasting and territory planning; title: Community Manager
description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the role You'll be the person who makes sure Adaptyv shows up well in public, every day. That means managing our social presence across X and LinkedIn, running the Proteinbase community, owning the participant side of our open competitions and hackathons, and triaging inbound community and customer messages. Whatever it takes to keep our community-facing surface area healthy as we grow. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll be the go-to person for anything community: content, social, events, and the day-to-day rhythm of how Adaptyv talks to the outside world. You'll work closely with the founders and the science team, and you'll have a direct impact on how the protein design and AI bio communities experience us. Responsibilities Manage Adaptyv's day-to-day social presence on X and LinkedIn: product updates, customer wins, blog amplifications, conference content, and reactive posts on what's happening in the field. Run the Proteinbase community day-to-day: newsletter, competition updates, designer spotlights, and the Slack where participants and contributors gather. Own the participant-facing side of our open competitions and hackathons, from applicant communication and rules through to judging logistics and post-event recaps. Turn each event into a public artifact (leaderboard, dataset, blog post). Triage inbound community and customer messages, routing deeper technical questions to the right person on the team. Coordinate with the founders and the science team on what to post, what to amplify, and what to hold. What we're looking for 1-3 years running social, content, or community for a technical company, a science-adjacent media brand, an event series, or a community platform. Self-built audiences and adjacent experience count equally. A strong, distinctive writing voice. You move between LinkedIn announcements, customer replies, and community posts without defaulting to generic AI phrasing. Genuine curiosity about biology and AI. No science degree required, but you should be able to follow technical conversations in protein design and AI without needing them explained. Highly organized. You'll juggle multiple channels, partnerships, and ongoing threads simultaneously, and build the systems to track them. Comfortable with ambiguity. There is no editorial calendar or playbook. You'll decide what's worth posting based on what we're shipping and what the field is discussing. Bonus: existing presence in protein design or AI bio circles, prior experience running a hackathon or competition, short-form video editing, or a track record of building a technical community from scratch. Location: On-site or remote, with timezone overlap with US or Europe. Occasional travel to Lausanne and to events. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. title: Head of Finance
description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role We are building the most automated lab in the world, and that does not stop at the bench. A company that AI agents can run experiments in has to automate everything around the experiment too — procurement, hiring, admin, and finance. Finance is one of the most automatable functions in any company and almost nobody has actually done it. We intend to. That is the job: build an AI-powered finance stack. Our ledger, billing, cards and payroll all expose APIs, and we already close the books against them programmatically rather than by hand. You would take that much further, to where the model, the close, the cash view and the margin analysis largely run themselves, and your week goes on the decisions instead of the reconciliation. You would be our first finance hire, and it is hands-on. You will build the forecast, run the close across two entities, own cash, and be the person who can say what a protein actually costs us to make. What You'll Do Own the forecast. Both directions: bottom-up from lab capacity, throughput and price per protein, and top-down P&L, burn and runway. Own gross margin. What does an experiment actually cost us — DNA, reagents, consumables, instrument time, labour? Which products and which customers lose us money? Own pricing, with commercial. What we charge, why, and where the floor is. Pricing at a lab company is a finance question wearing a sales hat. Own the close. Group consolidation and intercompany management. Make it fast, make it correct, make it boring. Own cash. Bank and card accounts across Switzerland and the US, AP runs, AR collection, payment timing. Know where the money is and where it is going before anyone asks. Keep us compliant. Tax, VAT, audit, payroll, and the external firms we work with. You are not a lawyer or an accountant, but you know when to call one. Investor reporting, fundraising support, and treasury management. Equipment leasing and asset management. The lab runs on millions of francs of instruments. Lease or buy, how we finance it, what it does to the balance sheet, and keeping the asset register honest as we expand. Automate all of the above. What We're Looking For You have built a finance function, not just worked in one. Several years in finance at a startup that actually scaled, and ideally you were early enough to have set things up rather than inherited them. You can build a real model. Not a template. A model that ties operational reality — throughput, yield, capacity, headcount — to cash, and that survives someone pulling on it. You write code, or you are visibly about to. SQL at minimum, Python ideally. This is the hard requirement most finance candidates will fail, and we mean it. We run on Claude Code across the company, and every system finance touches has an API behind it. The best version of this person automates their own function, writes their own tooling, and finds leverage the rest of us have not thought of. If your instinct is that finance is a spreadsheet-and-portal job, we will frustrate each other. You understand the cost structure of a physical business. Reagents, instruments, consumables, capex versus COGS, yield loss. Lab, hardware, or manufacturing backgrounds all translate. Pure SaaS finance does not, on its own. Swiss and European finance experience. VAT, social charges, employment law. A US entity alongside a Swiss one is a plus. Ambitious, and in it for the company. We want someone who intends to be running finance at a much larger Adaptyv in three years, and who cares about what we are building rather than the title on the door. Trustworthy with everything. Salaries, revenue, investor communications, board material. All of it crosses your desk. Scope We are a small company and nobody here has clean edges around their job. You will end up in the lab, in a room with a customer, and every so often doing something that is nobody's job simply because it needs doing. The centre of gravity is the numbers: the model, the close, cash, margin, pricing, and the board pack. That is the part that is yours and the part we will judge the role on. Procurement is a separate hire and the two of you will be joined at the hip on cost, but the sourcing and the vendor relationships are not yours to run. One thing it is not: a bookkeeping seat. The mechanical layer is handled, and if that is the job you want, this one will bore you. Why This Role Is Interesting Most first-finance-hires at a startup spend three years cleaning up a SaaS P&L. Here, the finance question and the product question are the same question: an automated lab is a machine for converting money into experimental data, and how efficiently it does that is literally the business. You will be building the model of that machine, at a company that is about to expand it several-fold, while it is being used by the best pharma companies and the best AI labs in the world. And you will do it with a founding team that will hand you the API keys and get out of your way. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis. description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. Based in San Francisco, this person leads regional market development initiatives across partnerships, startup communities, events, founder engagement and localized programs, helping position Notion as the preferred workspace for startups building the future with AI. Working closely with the Head of Startups and cross-functional teams, this role combines ecosystem knowledge, relationship building and execution excellence to grow startup awareness, product adoption and top-of-funnel pipeline across the region. This role is ideal for someone who understands the U.S startup ecosystem deeply, enjoys being close to founders, partners and is excited about building scalable regional growth initiatives in fast-moving markets. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. Its core areas include entitlements, licensing and provisioning, seat management, usage visibility, and cost management.</p> <p>The existing platform has served GitLab for approximately a decade and now faces significant challenges in scale, maintainability, and architectural complexity. This role will help us understand where we are today and define how Fulfillment should work over the next ten years.</p> <p>This is a senior player-coach role. You will set architectural direction across the Fulfillment portfolio, make critical technical decisions, and work directly with teams to execute the resulting modernization strategy. You will influence across organizational boundaries while remaining hands-on in design, implementation, technical problem-solving, and mentorship.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and communicate the long-term architecture and technical strategy for Fulfillment, including target state, principles, priorities, and migration sequencing.</li> <li>Assess the current platform and address its most important risks across scale, reliability, performance, data correctness, operability, and maintainability.</li> <li>Drive architectural decisions across entitlements, provisioning, seat management, usage visibility, and cost management.</li> <li>Establish clear service boundaries, data ownership, contracts, and integration patterns across Fulfillment, Monetization, billing, Salesforce, and product services.</li> <li>Lead an incremental modernization program that improves the existing platform while continuing to deliver customer and business value.</li> <li>Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Management, and cross-functional stakeholders to turn architectural direction into executable roadmaps and shipped outcomes.</li> <li>Be hands-on with the hardest problems, including prototypes, critical implementations, migrations, performance improvements, reliability work, and incident learning.</li> <li>Champion practical artificial intelligence (AI) adoption across Fulfillment, including agentic coding and AI-assisted engineering workflows, and help teams apply these tools responsibly and effectively.</li> <li>Mentor and coach Senior and Staff Engineers and raise the quality of technical decision-making across the organization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience at Staff, Principal, or equivalent technical leadership level.</li> <li>Direct experience building, operating, or modernizing Fulfillment systems, including areas such as entitlements, licensing, provisioning, subscription lifecycle, seat management, usage metering, usage billing, or cost controls.</li> <li>A track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams and turning architecture into reliable, operated systems.</li> <li>Deep experience with distributed systems, scalability, availability, performance, observability, data integrity, and failure-mode analysis.</li> <li>Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, and Python, with the ability to navigate both Backend and Frontend in a polyglot system.</li> <li>Practical experience using artificial intelligence in software engineering, including agentic coding or AI-assisted development workflows.</li> <li>Demonstrated success modernizing mature or degraded platforms without relying on a risky “big bang” rewrite.</li> <li>Experience designing systems that span multiple deployment models, such as software as a service, Self-Managed, Dedicated, or disconnected environments.</li> <li>Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to connect technical investment to customer experience, revenue, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and time to market.</li> <li>Excellent written communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across teams without formal authority.</li> </ul><div title: Software Engineer, Developer Platform
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Developer Platform https://www.notion.com/product/dev engineer, you will directly contribute to the foundational pieces that make Notion extensible and connected. You will build tools, APIs, and platform experiences that help customers connect Notion to the world — bringing their apps, data, and workflows into one workspace. Your work will make it easier for developers, admins, and builders to create reliable integrations and automations on top of Notion. You will be a key player in building the robust technical foundation that allows Notion to achieve the connected workspace vision. Your work will include both internal platform contributions that accelerate other Notion engineering teams and end-user-facing functionality that enables toolmaking ubiquity. You will be presented with challenging technical problems, as Notion’s product needs are complex. You’ll play a key role in identifying and executing against technical investments that ensure the long-term quality, reliability, and performance of Notion’s platform as we scale. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - You’ll work with a team of engineers and cross-functional partners across product, design, data science, and user research to define a product strategy and drive execution through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance. - You’ll evolve Developer Platform capabilities across APIs, MCP tools, and integration infrastructure that help customers automate workflows, customize Notion, and connect Notion to the tools and data they use every day. - You’ll contribute to the overall performance, reliability, and robustness of the Notion product, ensuring it scales elegantly across many dimensions. - You’ll partner with engineering leaders to identify and execute against high-leverage technical investments that ensure the long-term flexibility and sustainability of our core systems. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 7+ years of experience shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end - Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend - Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results NICE TO HAVES: - Experience building developer tools like APIs and SDKs - Experience driving teams toward shared goals and balancing business priorities with individuals’ strengths, areas of interest, and career development goals - Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits.
